findings.title: Recheck the production cache after acquiring the write lock
findings.body: Concurrent requests arriving before the cache is populated can all read a nil cache and then queue for the write lock. Each queued request subsequently reloads and parses the manifest even though the first request has already populated the cache, serializing redundant disk I/O and delaying requests during cold start. A later reload failure can also replace the successfully populated cache with nil and return an avoidable error. After acquiring the write lock, check the cache again and return it when running outside development mode.
